#8068 (merged on Nov 26) landed the same fix in `ResourceCluster.DoRead`: the cluster GET error now takes precedence over the library-status error, and it also cancels the library read. This PR is therefore redundant, so I'm closing it. #7565 is still open and looks resolved by #8068.
